name: Prophecies — Elementalist
author: Psysonic
description: Inspired by Guild Wars (2005). The Prophecies theme in the Elementalist's red: armour-violet surfaces, an engraved display face, and the profession's colour on the trim.

1.0.0: Profession variant of Prophecies in the Elementalist's red.
The accent is lightened from the profession's own colour so links and titles stay readable on a dark surface.
